oneOf.description: A knowledge concept; the derived file is `knowledge/<id>.md` and the first block is the frontmatter.
A markdown artifact (step 5).
A meeting's note (step 5).
A free-standing note (step 3).
An agent's charter — the body of `agents/<name>.md` (67 §6.1); the roster copies each export into the file.

A task's thread (67 §7.1): comments, answers and the event log of one task. Owned by the task,
so it never lists as a note.

A board (71 §2.1): a note the agent draws for a reader — sections, anchored prose, `Excerpt`s and
diagrams — bound like a note (`Binding::Note`, `documents/<id>/note.md`); its first block is the
frontmatter carrying `root:`, the absolute repository root every `code:` link and `ref` resolves against.

A notebook (144 §3.1): the container over notes, sources, sessions and artifacts. Its body is the
description the agent reads as a prompt block; its lists are `notebook_items` rows. Never lists
among notes.

A source (144 §3.1): read-only derived markdown of something fetched (file, URL, meeting, pasted
text, past session, MCP page, YouTube, audio, video) plus its insights. Bound by its origin key, so
the same thing is one document everywhere. Written by `Principal::Helper`/`File` only.

A Deck (229): a collaborative live dashboard/document — stable-ID sections, order, aliases and
read-only script metadata pointers in pure `yrs::Doc` root maps/arrays, no XML fragment and no
helper mirror. Executable Monty state and runtime churn live in `crates/decks`.

`state` (`backlog` | `todo`) defaults to `backlog` on the wire.

state.description: `backlog` (default: created, not dispatched) or `todo` (the owner is woken).

attachments.description: Attached references (design 66 refs), deduplicated by kind + id.

priority.description: Priority; `None` = medium. The ledger refuses it from an agent.

blockers.description:
Task ids or `decision:<id>` / `person:<name>` entries this task waits on — the
dependency edges of a plan, set at create time. Checked as in `task_update`: duplicates
dropped; an unknown task id or a list that would form a cycle refused. A `todo` task
with an open blocker is created `blocked`.
